title: Happy snake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#b6ff7a' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b6ff7a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='46' ry='42' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- body coil (outer) -->
  <path d='M30 78 C10 78 10 55 28 52 C46 49 54 40 68 40 C82 40 90 50 82 62 C76 71 62 74 52 70'
        fill='none' stroke='#2fbf5f' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body coil highlight -->
  <path d='M30 78 C10 78 10 55 28 52 C46 49 54 40 68 40 C82 40 90 50 82 62 C76 71 62 74 52 70'
        fill='none' stroke='#7ef2a0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' transform='translate(-2,-3)'/>

  <!-- neck rising up -->
  <path d='M52 70 C44 60 40 48 46 38'
        fill='none' stroke='#2fbf5f' stroke-width='13' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 70 C44 60 40 48 46 38'
        fill='none' stroke='#7ef2a0' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round' transform='translate(-1,-3)'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='30' rx='16' ry='13' fill='#2fbf5f'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='27' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#7ef2a0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M31 33 L22 36 M22 36 L18 33 M22 36 L18 39' stroke='#ff5a8a' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='27' r='4.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='27' r='4.5' fill='#fff9c4'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='27.5' r='2.2' fill='#1f6b39'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='27.5' r='2.2' fill='#1f6b39'/>
  <circle cx='42.8' cy='26.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55.8' cy='26.4' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 35 Q48 39 54 34' stroke='#1f6b39' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>

  <!-- cheek spots -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='33' r='2' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='33' r='2' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- tail tip -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='78' r='7' fill='#2fbf5f'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='76' r='3' fill='#7ef2a0' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
